summary: Iteration 8: validated STEP-ELIGIBILITY gating (canBook/canDeliver/canClose) and SCHEME company-share split end-to-end. 9 backend pytests pass (1 skipped: no Delivered lead in baseline). Frontend LeadDrawer footer correctly gates Convert-to-Booking on booked leads and shows the Booked ✓ badge; Scheme tab preview labels match spec; Partial Benefit reveals breakup inputs. Owner sees Dealer Earnings nav, Executive does not; public /share loads. Backend 100% (9/9), Frontend 100% on tested flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Badge did not forward extra props (e.g. data-testid), so <Badge data-testid="already-booked-badge"> rendered without the attribute. Fixed by spreading ...rest onto the span so all test IDs on Badge now work (already-booked-badge, already-delivered-badge, and any future Badge-based selectors).

action_items: Consider adding a 'reset lead scheme to zero' or 'reseed' admin endpoint — currently the test does the reset manually. Not blocking.

Baseline mutation notice: LD26000005 has now been converted to Booked (single mutation as allowed by the request). Bookings count moved 3 -> 4. If a pristine baseline is required for later iterations, main agent should reseed.
critical_code_review_comments: components/ui.js Badge did not spread props (breaks any data-testid or aria-* attributes passed to it). Fixed in this iteration.

server.py delivery endpoint: mark_delivery only enforces canDeliver when body.delivered is Yes AND lead is not already delivered. Non-delivered paperwork updates on a non-active lead are still allowed — probably fine but worth documenting.
SchemeTab preview labels differ between drawer footer overview ('OEM Claimable (Company Share)') and Scheme tab preview ('OEM Claimable (Co. Share)'). Consider unifying copy for consistency.
recompute_lead persists derived fields but PUT /leads/{id} (update_lead) now uses exclude_unset — good; ensure the frontend EditLeadModal continues to send only intended fields.
test_credentials: Owner: owner@euler.com / euler@123 ; Executive: executive@euler.com / euler@123
seed_data_creation: None new. Mutated LD26000005 (New -> Booked, ₹5000 booking advance) as the single allowed conversion. Reset scheme fields on LD26000006 back to zero+Full Benefit after scheme test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend gating & scheme share-split verified live against seed data. Key evidence: (1) POST /leads/LD26000003/convert-booking -> 409; (2) PUT /leads/LD26000005/delivery{delivered:Yes} on New -> 409; (3) GET /leads/LD26000003/360 returns actions{canBook:false,isBooked:true,canDeliver:true,canClose:true}; GET /leads/LD26000005/360 returns actions{canBook:true,canDeliver:false,isBooked:false} PRIOR to conversion (after conversion in this run, LD26000005 is now Booked); (4) PUT /leads/{id}/scheme with consumerDiscount=20000+exchangeBonus=15000 on an Active lead computes companyOutstanding <= raw offer sum (Scheme Master caps applied); (5) GET /reports/dealer-earnings returns {byMonth, components, totals}; (6) executive gets 401/403 on /reports/dealer-earnings, /reports/insurance-payout, /dealer-earnings. UI: LD26000003 drawer footer shows Booked ✓ badge (data-testid=already-booked-badge) and NO convert-booking-btn; LD26000006 shows convert-booking-btn and no booked badge. Scheme tab preview shows 'OEM Claimable (Co. Share)' + 'Dealer Scheme Retained'; benefit-mode=Partial Benefit reveals breakup-<key> inputs (verified consumerDiscount + exchangeBonus). Public /share loads with 'Active Bookings' + 'All Leads'. Executive session lacks 'Dealer Earnings' in sidebar. IMPORTANT: LD26000005 is now Booked in the baseline; future tests that expect it to be a 'New' lead must switch to LD26000006/7/8/9/10. Also, the Badge data-testid forwarding fix in ui.js is a small but important shared-component patch — all consumers of <Badge data-testid=...> now work.
rca of the issue: Missing data-testid on already-booked-badge was traced to shared Badge component not forwarding extra props. Fixed via {...rest} spread on the wrapping <span>. Rest of the review request items were already correctly implemented in the codebase.
